aka: 金石新創投資股份有限公司

funds.name: 金石首富基金 (Paragon Propeller Fund)
金石創富基金 (Paragon Wealth Creation Fund)

strategy.thesis: Self-described as a 'touchstone' (試金石) for startups going global; focuses on high-growth digital technology — Big Data, AI and Software — bridging Taiwan with Silicon Valley and Greater China. Portfolio explicitly includes data-infrastructure plays such as GRAID (GPU-based RAID/storage) and Gemini Data (big-data analytics).

summary.en: Taipei-based early-stage VC (founded 2018) focused on Big Data, AI and Software. Manages the Paragon Propeller (2019) and Paragon Wealth Creation (2020) funds and has backed data-infrastructure companies including GRAID and Gemini Data.
summary.local: 2018 年成立於台北內湖的早期創投，專注於大數據、AI 與軟體等高成長數位科技，分別於 2019、2020 年募集金石首富基金與金石創富基金，投資組合含資料基礎建設新創 GRAID、大數據分析新創 Gemini Data。

strategy.thesis: 'VC = Value Creation' — an Asia-focused active VC that joins portfolio companies as a co-founding partner, using data-driven methods to improve business structure and operational efficiency. Identifies enterprise SaaS as a core opportunity for Taiwan startups; partners cite 25+ years of combined hardware/software industry and investment experience.

summary.en: Taipei-based active VC positioning itself as a 'Value Creation' partner for Pre-A/A/B stage companies in Asia, with a stated interest in enterprise SaaS as a key Taiwan startup opportunity.

aka: 精誠資訊股份有限公司

strategy.thesis: Taiwan's largest IT-services group, self-positioned as 'a Data Software Company' built on six core capabilities (software, data, algorithms, cloud, solution architecture, cybersecurity). Makes corporate/strategic investments (轉投資) in data and software startups — e.g. it backed Silicon Valley big-data/AI-data startup Gemini Data — and runs an AI+ Generator Program for startups.

aka: 零壹科技股份有限公司

strategy.thesis: Listed (TWSE: 3029) enterprise-IT distributor and systems integrator covering AI-enabled IT infrastructure, cloud computing/services, cybersecurity resilience and AI applications. Makes strategic CVC investments into AI-infrastructure/software startups it also distributes — e.g. it led the Series A of INFINITIX (數位無限), a GPU-scheduling / AI-infrastructure management software firm.

summary.en: Listed Taiwanese enterprise-IT distributor/integrator (TWSE 3029, founded 1980) spanning AI infrastructure, cloud and cybersecurity. Acts as a strategic CVC, leading the Series A of AI-infrastructure software startup INFINITIX.
summary.local: 1980 年成立的上市企業 IT 通路與系統整合商（股票代號 3029），業務涵蓋 AI 化 IT 基建、雲端與資安。以策略型企業創投領投 AI 基礎設施軟體新創 INFINITIX（數位無限）A 輪。

summary.en: Japan-Taiwan cross-border fund series (since 2011) jointly managed by ITIC (ITRI subsidiary) and Mitsubishi UFJ Capital. Three funds ($15M / $50M / $49.5M); backs software/data and deep-tech ventures including SaaS firm Kdan.
